name: script-v2
idea_origin: Formato line: script-v1 (script decides everything) lost a game at L1 on story readings; t13-read-v4 (DeepSeek decides stories) scored 71.67 but never fills Stalled and never moves Energy to Skill. Hybrid: DeepSeek keeps v4's story rules; the script keeps the status line (Best, Stalled) and plans each quarter.
hypothesis: Moving only the bookkeeping DeepSeek fails at (stall detection, best values, quarterly allocation) into a script keeps v4's story quality and adds the ceiling lever (+5 to +9 in the replica, B22) at ~60 extra tool calls per game.
predicted_behaviour: Status line with Stalled filled from the first L1 quarter; Energy moves to Skill once Network and Output stall; level L5-L6 at month 48.
refutation: Official games score below t13-read-v4 or the agent stops calling the script.
